text: In twenty twenty-five, the US Coast Guard's investigation called the disaster preventable. It found the design had never been properly tested, or checked by independent inspectors. The company that built Titan suspended all its operations soon after the accident. Certified deep submersibles are inspected by outside experts, and their hulls are pressure-tested beyond the depth they'll dive to. One titanium-sphere submersible has dived to the deepest point in the ocean again and again. Almost three times deeper than the Titanic. The deep ocean doesn't forgive shortcuts. A new idea has to be proven before people climb inside. Should deep-sea trips follow the same strict rules as airliners? Tell me what you think in the comments.
